name: storyboard
description: KOZMOS Storyboard: Claude narrates its own progress. A chapter tool the model calls at each phase change drives a band above the prompt: the chapter title, a five-stage rail (explore, plan, build, verify, ship) with the active stage glowing, step 3/5 and a note. /storyboard toggles the band, /storyboard log opens the chapter history.

nudge.title: Nudge the model
nudge.description: Add one short system-prompt line asking Claude to call the chapter tool at phase changes on multi-step tasks.

autoOpen.title: Open the log on start
autoOpen.description: Open the chapter-history pane when a session starts.
